notes.title: The Weekly Roundup 22/9/25 - Shady Lewd Kart Last Chance Content!!!
notes.content:
[p][b]This will be the last week we break down the map of Shady Lewd Karts production in a weekly roundup. Last week we covered DLC and the week before was the complete roadmap. But this week I want to give you peeps one last chance to get content. We cannot post the link to our p@tren but its easy to find on google. datgame in your search engine.

Funding a game like this isnt easy. Its from contributions of Patreon and sales of the game. But some things have been cut. Today I want to offer one last chance. If we hit some awesome goals I will cover any addditional costs to get these into the game. Meaning anything we dont account for.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/5129d4afd4982af9ffdeccc3f03b91312b6e468d.png"][/img]
[b]So lets take a look at the second dates. Each pit girl was going to get a second date. Something that we wanted to make for every driver. The biggest cost is voice work. Thats where it crunches into the budget. Everything else is pretty standard but writing new dialouge doesnt come cheap.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/7c2bc9d5b611b0ed04188086d8777ea9bc72e86e.png"][/img][b]If we could hit a goal of $1200 a month on Patreon we could get Sunny's cup. Meaning we could put Midnight in his own saga. A story about the tracks taking on a magical trap scenario where the tracks would be riddled in chaos. You would end up dating Midnight meaning more guy action and of course go up against Dave driving a train called the 9 3/4 Incher. Truly a magical time to return to Stars Reach for another year at wizard college![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/d731d5b104cd91a74835da7bd015a08e63cfec41.png"][/img]

[b]With Onyx we want to work with YOU the peeps to write this one. Make something you could shape. If we hit the goal we could talk to you and take votes from fans on where and what direction this one goes. Who would be the alt pit girl? What would happen to the tracks. This one is all on you![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/7bad0106fc6aa05954d41ccd6a7cdd333e02d144.png"][/img][b]Now if we hit $1500 id be happy to add a second date for detour into the mix. Since we already funded her date coming up in the seasonal cup I wanted a chance to give you the ultimate challenge. Detour making new roads to go down but the twist. Hit the cones and you lose all your dating items. It would be the true dating test to end all tests. Detour again would have another fully voiced story with a few twists and turns and you get to unlock even more lewds of your favorite traffic light.

All of these would unlock once you complete Episode 1 dates of each girl so these would be much like Vie's and Silvies second dates. New dialouge, new challenges, new unlocks and new lewds.

I figured as we are heading into the final turn of Shady Lewd Kart that this would be our last chance to hit these goals. If we can hold any of these goals for a full month I can fund them by putting away cash for each one. But this comes down to you. The players, the fans and you gooners.

This weeks update is in your hands. 

- Shades[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Weekly Roundup 16/9/25 - Shady Lewd Kart DLC Roadmap!!!
notes.content:
[p][b]This week I wanted to talk to you all about the DLC roadmap of Shady Lewd Kart. This is a pretty loaded topic as I hate games that will run DLC to the point its worth more than the game. [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]I think the idea of DLC is to give the game some extra eyes while also some delayed content after the 1.0 release while also funding content within the games production.[/b][/p][p][b]But dont worry we wont do what Dead or Alive 5 did and have over $1000 of DLC.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/31c040f2831336da53846f19f7cf822f7199ff48.png"][/img]
[b]So first up lets talk about what has already been released from our list. Originally we only planned for one being Wild Woody.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/a5b6bd29ad35e30d374a91a694cdc3fd7e2465e0.png"][/img][b]Pyramid Tits was a result of the original roster. Back in the day of making Shady Lewd Kart our game wasnt meant to be the 'smash' of kart racers.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/fc897a05bbff1f84974ea24dd67fae8a15d8371b.jpg"][/img][b]In the original design doc we had only planned for a few racers. This was originally drawn in 2018. How time flies when we pitched the game to the team![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/022e4f5df522080889f2da3f8559bd0f93ab26aa.png"][/img][b]Then when we started making the games early builds we grew to a roster that went from a simple game of parody characters to guest characters. A lot of devs grabbed onto the idea so it took form that guests would drive the game forward. Pyramid Tits was meant to be the original base idea of many girls that were to be parodies of sexy or retro games.[/b][/p][p][b]Bringing her back was more of a love letter for you guys who stuck around this long. I wanted to bring back lost media to the game that was cast aside back in 2019. If we are going out with a bang I want you want it to be a celebration of our lewd kart racer.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/6acac98fd457aabb9557f85fde7ad6e25ab8f030.png"][/img]
[b]So DLC 3 brings a character that is original that will be parodying games like Pyramid. I feel this one will be a funny blast once its revealed.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/3087bd2f6edc6c0bda4a1c9e44e1ea1163ca239d.png"][/img][b]Then during the holidays we hope to push a Seasonal Cup funded by myself. Each year we have added a new christmas or halloween based track and since then we now have a full cup. I figure we might as well make it a fully functional cup so you can play through the cup. Lets hope we can hit that mark.[/b][/p][p][b]During the new year we will be finishing the Thigh High Cup. As we have a bunch of spare tracks such as Detours Car Park and Marble Maid earlier the year before we hit the goal to finish it as a funded date with Detour. Its going to be cute. You will be able to date your traffic wife at long last in her own fully voiced story![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/9765e796cf79ec47c24b4810a3f4cfdc7019db25.png"][/img]
[b]In terms of what is after we want to go out with a bang so the last two are free. One of them will really be more of a joke being April Fools. Something that was tinkering around my head for a while. Seems stupid on paper but this day as a release would be perfect.[/b] 

[b]The DLC Voice Pack is something that was cut content. We had planned that the commentator could be swapped out. The voices for the most part were worked on for two packs. But our goal with it is to at least release one of them fully completed as sort of another gift to you the players.[/b] [b]

Next week we would love to give you an update on the future of remaining content. Such as the cups that were not funded. A chance for one more round of funding!!![/b] [b]

- Shades[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Weekly Roundup 10/9/25 - Shady Lewd Kart Roadmap Update!!!!
notes.content:
[p][b]This week is a big one and one where YOU the peeps want to know what is coming for our flagship game Shady Lewd Kart. So I have spent the past week preparing the final map of things. So lets dive into each part.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/6a1c29457a152e29f0d64fc660077e939c9de9e9.png"][/img][b]First off its been a huge year for us. with the big Feb update with new areans and cheats implimented. Our first DLC and Lovense Tourney through April and May. Then across the year to June we hit you with The final thot work in progress, more events and a plans to get you the final mode of the game.

I will say its been rough seas this year as we wanted to finish Kart in December but we are working as fast as we can while making sure you the players get what you want. Maybe a little feature creep here and there while still maintaing course.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/306f30576dec4c196f9ca0b45e40cab38590c028.png"][/img]
[b]Now that we are in September we are playing catchup as the censorship (we know you are sick of hearing it) as well as some set backs have got us a little behind. But with a beefy update planned for September including all new skins, hats, a new arena and a slick new mode it will fill the game with so much content to look back at the lovense tourney at.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/fd558514dcf96ac4f9cc4d9daf1951e9ff6028e1.png"][/img][b]Also it seems a new racer will be joining the ranks end of Sepetember but we have some interesting developments regarding this build we are working on. As we believe we can connect this to our October plans.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/cbdb9f3ec0f0ce9263c22c61db14e21db4974ece.png"][/img]

[b]Our goal here is if we finish September early we will roll into October straight away. With our final Halloween in game event along with more work for Final Thot Mode. including adding the mission color palate unlocks, bosses and the final in game cutscenes to really book end the game. Along with the fan voted track Clussy Fever Carnival.

Also our third character DLC will drop...and this one is going to be a blast...

If worse come to worse we will combine these months together as a big update to help push out more content and get us a step closer for you to a completed game.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/8c4fa118a6728eb739a864e3c28d7c3b40aa1810.png"][/img]
[b]December is our tying loose ends month. As what we are doing here is making sure the Final Thot mode has its final track built. The secret Panties cutscene implimented along with Jukebox mode. A behind the scenes gallery of unlocks and paperwork of sketches and designs never released for the game.

Also a DLC Cup that will tie together marking what will be a big DLC more so to fund the completion of the games foundations for Final Thot mode. These are going to be funded out of my own pocket to at least give the Seasonal tracks some flavor. Also something you Silvie X Detour fans can chew on through the holidays.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/8fa9091b5099f1c69e0d4a6abf832baffc97f17c.png"][/img]
[b]Then to bring it all home rolling into 2026 we have a rough draft being that the Final Touchups for Final Thot Mode will be done as well as the 1.0 release of Shady Lewd Kart. Marking that the game will at long last be out of early access and the game complete at its core.

Part of this final touchup we have 5 new racers????? How does that work? A second cup DLC as a thank you to all fans of Shady Lewd Kart marking this as our 5th DLC and biggest to date with a date with someone you have been waiting on for a long time.
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/83436fd117b5020b42d2188bbbbf316b73c2b1c5.png"][/img]
[b]A final April Fools DLC that will be sure to keep you cleaning up after all the races are done. This one we are aiming to be more of a joke than anything. Along with some lost Voice Pack DLC if we get time along with some community events to send Kart out with a Bang![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/5340ef5ca21e077a9ea712ccb5acb5a8eb350a6d.png"][/img]
[b]And then at long last. The end? Yep we will have a complete Shady Lewd Kart. But we do have something we did want to talk about which is something we did lose on the cutting room floor many years ago.
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/905645ac76e4c1430bb275ce00b30c471c0f93cf.png"][/img]
[b]Both Sunny and Onyx never got their Episodic Date 2 so if we manage to boost our patreon again and try and double our funding we will aim to get these both slipped in. We cannot promise anything but honestly if we got the funding to make this happen we could at least finish what we started with both the girls getting the same treatment as Silvie and Talia.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Welp...thats it. we have layed out a LOT of new info for you peeps. More than I would normally share. But this weeks weekly wrap is my call to arms for you. We want you to support Shady Lewd Kart till the very end. We have so much more to showcase and we are closer than ever before in finishing one of the biggest lewd games ever![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Help us get to the finish line![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]As always thank you for taking the time to read these. I know they are a lot but your support in our projects means the world to me. You peeps got us this far and I will always be so greatful for that. Stay tuned for next weeks regular update. [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]- Shades[/b][/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/d5c62ef9b4261aac60b43d6a20933fdb6a9a3951.png"][/img]We launched the update that came with a LOT of new content to keep you busy with Minotaress and Waifu Pillow along with returning events anc new skins and cheats. But our work didnt stop there. We are still working through patches as we work on the next update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/af7ba436ed5bb90d52401f764c3f1ad1ffa61af2.png"][/img][/p][p]As promised the LewdTubers are getting costumes in game with Batty, Ivy and KiraPRaptor to start. If you feel you want to help, supporting us and sharing and writing to your local goverment helps. Every note does. Right now our future of adult games is uncertain so please again be kind to me and the team as we work through this.

[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Korvald was one such scribe.

notes.title: The Weekly Round Up 14/11/23 - The Major Update Behind the Scenes
notes.content:
We dropped the Shady Lewd Kart direct this past week. With a bunch of new racers and content. Being on of the biggest updates we have done for the game yet!
[previewyoutube=qhIYnT7zSiw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
With Onyx from Pure Onyx joining Kart, Hayley from Dreamcutter and Tentacle Locker just to name the base of this build. Its been jam packed and one hell of a task to move this one out. So thank you again for waiting on this one. All events only have a few days left so get out on the track.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/f50d1be3b3210d4692503eec3c5b46abc5998e3f.png[/img]
Also we can showcase some behind the scenes as the update is live. With Silviesaurus being one of the earliest ideas we had for Kart. Modeling her only occured last month though and to get her into the game was a task in itself with her moveset.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/9f3aac02d22fbe387325a11728aaffedf1cbdb3a.png[/img]
In the end she really does seem like a very unique racer. Using all four feet to run around the track and as big as Artimus she really does have a dominating feel on the track.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/54a05e46159712f0389445e4b9fd0864fd87e659.png[/img]
One of the last things we almost missed in this update was the damage bubble. So many things can slip through the cracks but we were lucky to grab this one when we did. As always Ducky's sketch work is on point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/ab1a3013d65444c002c09ed0b6abba0f14dc5885.png[/img]
Im keen to see who mains Silviesaurus now as there seems to be a lot of people that really love the fact we have a giant dinosaur in the game haha
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/18869734f70ed9a3136161b4c9cfe1e5f5f663d3.png[/img]
Tentacle Locker was another challenge but Molegato was quite creative with the tentacles for the steering. As well as animations. A lot of this early testing we wanted the locker to bend and have life that would animate through the locker.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/1d11bb8fe549705038d36700a2388fb617803cd6.png[/img]
I think in an odd way Tentacle Locker is on of my favorite racers just because of its strange addition to the roster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/476708356c177d9dabcce5cb5263ae54caa4b096.png[/img]
Also the story was quite simple to make. We wanted Tentacle locker to be a part of the world straight away. So it felt right that Silvie was keeping something in her work locker and it also gave us an excuse to destroy her again.

Thats it for this past week. Go get that Shady Lewd Kart update. Its going to keep you busy this week. Also dont forget to preorder Slime Girl Smoothies on Switch! Have time after that watch our videos and share our patreon! Each bit of support helps us grow!

-Shades

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36751909/d694de86ef241e208d9c355fe44a476fdc2baf28.png[/img]
Where the hell Jan went we will never know. The last month we have been planning out the route for the first Q1 of #shady_lewd_kart. Its a tough road to walk if we want to start bringing the game to a close in a year or so, and we thank you for powering through with us to help finish it!

This next update is going to be a big one but we are still debating if we split it. 90% of the artwork and UI is done. We have new characters, a tease of Pitgirl Number 4, 2 new tracks (one being an arena), hats, a new mode, and a new event type.

Most of what we want to focus on this year is also the polish and refinement. Making menus look slicker. The last parts of the beta build being remade, gallery tags being updated and track changes. One track being Hentai XXXpress. Retooling that track will be a task but the turning on it needs to be addressed this year. Thats including control support and of course any adjustments we can make to make your kart experience perfect.

With new characters comes new unlocks. The artwork is some of our best yet. With some very talented artists old and new! 

Stay tuned for the next few weeks as we sprinkle out sketches, concepts and new content for kart! As always thank you so very much from the bottom of my heart. The support for Kart and our games is so overwhelming, I cannot wait for the rest of this year. 2023 is going to be a wild ride!

notes.title: A Word From Shades! (Thank You)

Hey peeps wanted to touch base as we are at the end of the month! Don't forget if you want your rewards, demos and tier gifts make sure you keep your Patreon pledge details up to date.

I want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has been supporting us. It has been scary to get this far as now we are growing every day. [b]SHADY LEWD KART[/b]
We are implementing in the Detour Driving School Mechanic. Been working on it all week. Just needs voice work and rewards system and you are all good to go to test it out! Its honestly very exciting that Kart keeps growing. The in game events really showed us we need to keep doing these to drum up more hype and eyes on people.

[b]SHADY CORNER VIDEOS[/b]
New videos are coming. I filmed over 15 new reviews and sketches and have over 30 interviews to put out. I know this year has been tough with content but hang tight. Working as fast as we can. The hardest part has been moving office. Getting settled in. And trying new things with videos. So I hope your ready for them!

[b]NEW MERCH[/b]
Shady Kart Merch  [url=https://gumroad.com/shadycornergames]https://gumroad.com/shadycornergames[/url] has been going crazy! Its nice to see the support on all fronts. The Silvie and Shades figure and of course the mouse pads too! We have more merch coming so hang tight. We want to slowly trickle it out so you can get your lewd hands on some awesome Shady Kart Merch.

[b]NEW GAMES?[/b]
I have been for a while working on a few other games. Lewd Kart really took my full attention but now I can get back to things like Dirty Laundry and trying to do something with Okonomiyaki. Both projects went on hold for the powerhouse that is Kart. Meanwhile I have a B Team working on finishing up a new demo for a game we are working on. Something you wouldnt expect to be lewd. Its a cute little side projects and very keen to share it with you!

[b]AND OF COURSE ME (Shades)[/b]
Ive been doing okay. Very burnt out. I decided this week while the team works I would take some time for myself. Not just to settle in but to enjoy my games room and life a little. Taking my time has never been a thing for me but health comes first. So I have cut a lot from my plate in order to relax more. Enjoy the content I make and the games Im making.

I hope you stick with me as I continue to make new and exciting content and games! Thank you for your support. Love you peeps!

https://www.patreon.com/datgame   is the place to be. You can vote on racers, art and positions. As well as see what we are cooking up in the lewd labs of Shady Corner! We have huge goals for Shady Lewd Kart, from animated scenes, more modes and ways to make you finish early ;)

[b]Will the game get even lewder?[/b]
YES! We are working on a really cool orgasm time trial mode as well as clothing ripping mechanics for racers!

[b]When will multiplayer be ready?[/b]
Currently we have same couch gameplay for multiplayer for you and your partner, but we are working on Steams multiplayer. So unless you want to invite a friend over to play a hentai game (that would be a first) I can only say please wait as we make sure that it is fully working before we release online multiplayer to you all!

[b]Will 'X' character be in the game?[/b]
We have over 60 characters planned for Kart but that doesnt mean we dont want to hear what you have to say! Let us know who you think should be in or who you may predict?

[b]Where can I see the latest news besides Patreon?[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/user/NSFWGamerVids Our youtube channel we launch trailers, as well as Shady Lewd Kart Directs. Giving you peeps a first hand look at the latest reveals. Otherwise join our discord: https://discord.gg/5qBx5bU

[b]I want more game my pp need more plz![/b]
We are working on an amazing update for Easter so hang tight! As well as our special driving school mode. Updates happen every month from bug fixes to new content so try and edge yourself a bit ;)

Any other questions just drop them in the discussions thread and Il get to them asap! Bugs, details, or more let us know!

Thank you, for letting Shady Lewd Kart into your steam library! Lets begin this lewd journey!

- Shades
